title.narrative: UNDP - Development & Emergency Programme in Palestine

description.narrative:
This agreement is signed to cover two projects with UNDP as implementing partner: 1) The Debris Management project aims to address the severe impacts of the debris crisis in Gaza through a risk-managed approach to debris removal, recycling, and disposal. The project will benefit over 750,000 individuals by reducing health and safety risks, restoring access to essential services, and supporting long-term recovery and reconstruction.
2) Solar units for water wells in the West Bank aims to integrate a 1.8 MW solar PV system and energy efficiency measures at 15 water wells in the West Bank to enhance operational sustainability, reduce electricity costs, and support sustainable water production.
